item.title: CVE-2026-59191: TwigView FileLoader may allow arbitrary file reads through user-controlled template paths
item.description:
Severity: medium. ### Impact If `FileLoader::findTemplate()` is supplied un-validated user controlled data, arbitrary files can be read.
### Patches 1.3.3 and 2.1.2 contain a fix for this issue.
